text:
maya: quick heads-up  I flipped solstice-int6 into staging (canary 10%) and the short-tail holdout (<=18 tokens) shows Recall@1 dip vs baseline. anyone see this? :confused:

infra-bot: deploy complete  solstice-int6 -> staging (canary 10%). console: https://console.redwood.ai/staging/models/solstice

oren: re-ran a tiny eval against the canary. command:
```bash
python eval_recall.py --model solstice-int6 --queries holdout/short_tail.json --k 1 --seed 11
```
output:
```text
Recall@1: 0.61
Baseline (atlas-v3): 0.69
```

kai: per-lang quick peek (N=500 each):
```text
lang  baseline  solstice-int6  delta
en    0.70      0.66         -0.04
fr    0.68      0.54         -0.14
```

oren: we have solstice-int8_pc built in staging but not routed. suspect 6-bit config is aggressive on short subword-heavy queries.

maya: can we route FR/short to int8_pc without redeploy?

devex-bot: yes. example:
```bash
redwood route add-rule --model solstice --condition "tokens <= 18 and lang == 'fr'" --variant int8_pc --env staging
redwood model set-variant --model solstice --variant int8_pc --traffic 10 --env staging
```

oren: added 10% traffic to int8_pc and reran eval on that slice. int8_pc numbers:
```text
Recall@1: 0.67
Baseline: 0.69
delta_fr: -0.02
```

kai: nice recovery. plan: run 5k stratified short eval overnight, monitor churn@1 and cosine-delta hist, and add per-lang recall alert at 0.03 absolute. will sync tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
